researcherObservation: Both E09 checks observe uncommitted search draft instead of committed pregled after navigating to task details. Actual App.tsx draft-reset effect depends on project.id,view,q,status,order and omits taskId; a detail-only navigation preserves these dependencies. This is one duplicated functional R09 gap, not the punctuation/region sensitivity of other submissions.
